verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: E VEIO a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֔ם שָׂ֥א עַל־ צֹ֖ר קִינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām śā ‘al- ṣōr qî·nāh
verses.literal: Now you son of man take up a lament for Tyre
verses.literalPt: Tu pois, ó filho do homem, levanta uma lamentação sobre Tiro.

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ לְצ֗וֹר הַיֹּשַׁבְתִּי עַל־ מְבוֹאֹ֣ת יָ֔ם רֹכֶ֙לֶת֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֶל־ אִיִּ֖ים רַבִּ֑ים כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה צ֕וֹר אַ֣תְּ אָמַ֔רְתְּ אֲנִ֖י כְּלִ֥ילַת יֹֽפִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā lə·ṣō·wr hay·yō·šaḇ·tī ‘al- mə·ḇō·w·’ōṯ yām rō·ḵe·leṯ hā·‘am·mîm ’el- ’î·yîm rab·bîm kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣō·wr ’at ’ā·mart ’ă·nî kə·lî·laṯ yō·p̄î
verses.literal: Tell Tyre who dwells at the gateway to the sea merchant of the peoples on many coasts that this is what the Lord GOD says You have said O Tyre I am perfect in beauty
verses.literalPt: E dize a Tiro, que habita nas entradas do mar, e negocia com os povos em muitas ilhas: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ó Tiro, tu dizes: Eu sou perfeita em formosura.

verses.original: בְּלֵ֥ב יַמִּ֖ים גְּבוּלָ֑יִךְ בֹּנַ֕יִךְ כָּלְל֖וּ יָפְיֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·lêḇ yam·mîm gə·ḇū·lā·yiḵ bō·na·yiḵ kā·lə·lū yā·p̄ə·yêḵ
verses.literal: Your borders are in the heart of the seas your builders perfected your beauty
verses.literalPt: No coração dos mares estão os teus termos; os que te edificaram aperfeiçoaram a tua formosura.

verses.original: בְּרוֹשִׁ֤ים מִשְּׂנִיר֙ בָּ֣נוּ לָ֔ךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ לֻֽחֹתָ֑יִם אֶ֤רֶז מִלְּבָנוֹן֙ לָקָ֔חוּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת תֹּ֖רֶן עָלָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rō·wō·šîm miś·śə·nîr bā·nū lāḵ ’êṯ kāl- lu·ḥō·ṯā·yim ’e·rez mil·lə·ḇā·nō·wn lā·qā·ḥū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ tō·ren ‘ā·lā·yiḵ
verses.literal: They constructed all your planking with cypress from Senir They took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you
verses.literalPt: Fabricaram todos os teus conveses de faias de Senir; trouxeram cedros do Líbano para te fazerem mastros.

verses.original: אַלּוֹנִים֙ מִבָּ֔שָׁן עָשׂ֖וּ מִשּׁוֹטָ֑יִךְ קַרְשֵׁ֤ךְ עָֽשׂוּ־ שֵׁן֙ בַּת־ אֲשֻׁרִ֔ים מֵאִיֵּ֖י כִּתִּיִּם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al·lō·w·nîm mib·bā·šān ‘ā·śū miš·šō·w·ṭā·yiḵ qar·šêḵ ‘ā·śū- šên baṯ- ’ă·šu·rîm mê·’î·yê kit·tī·yim
verses.literal: Of oaks from Bashan they made your oars of wood from the coasts of Cyprus they made your deck inlaid with ivory . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Fizeram os teus remos de carvalhos de Basã; os teus bancos fizeram-nos de marfim engastado em buxo das ilhas dos quiteus.

verses.original: שֵׁשׁ־ בְּרִקְמָ֤ה מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ הָיָ֣ה מִפְרָשֵׂ֔ךְ לִהְי֥וֹת לָ֖ךְ לְנֵ֑ס תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן מֵאִיֵּ֥י אֱלִישָׁ֖ה הָיָ֥ה מְכַסֵּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: šêš- bə·riq·māh mim·miṣ·ra·yim hā·yāh mip̄·rā·śêḵ lih·yō·wṯ lāḵ lə·nês tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān mê·’î·yê ’ĕ·lî·šāh hā·yāh mə·ḵas·sêḵ
verses.literal: Of embroidered fine linen from Egypt they made your sail which served as your banner Of blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah they made your awning
verses.literalPt: Linho fino bordado do Egito era a tua cortina, para te servir de vela; azul e púrpura das ilhas de Elisá era a tua cobertura.

verses.original: יֹשְׁבֵ֤י צִידוֹן֙ וְאַרְוַ֔ד הָי֥וּ שָׁטִ֖ים לָ֑ךְ חֲכָמַ֤יִךְ צוֹר֙ הָ֣יוּ בָ֔ךְ הֵ֖מָּה חֹבְלָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: yō·šə·ḇê ṣî·ḏō·wn wə·’ar·waḏ hā·yū šā·ṭîm lāḵ ḥă·ḵā·ma·yiḵ ṣō·wr hā·yū ḇāḵ hêm·māh ḥō·ḇə·lā·yiḵ
verses.literal: The men of Sidon and Arvad were your oarsmen Your men of skill O Tyre were there as your captains
verses.literalPt: Os moradores de Sidom e de Arvade foram os teus remadores; os teus sábios, ó Tiro, que se achavam em ti, esses foram os teus pilotos.

verses.original: זִקְנֵ֨י גְבַ֤ל וַחֲכָמֶ֙יהָ֙ הָ֣יוּ בָ֔ךְ מַחֲזִיקֵ֖י בִּדְקֵ֑ךְ כָּל־ אֳנִיּ֨וֹת הַיָּ֤ם וּמַלָּֽחֵיהֶם֙ הָ֣יוּ בָ֔ךְ לַעֲרֹ֖ב מַעֲרָבֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ziq·nê ḡə·ḇal wa·ḥă·ḵā·me·hā hā·yū ḇāḵ ma·ḥă·zî·qê biḏ·qêḵ kāl- ’o·nî·yō·wṯ hay·yām ū·mal·lā·ḥê·hem hā·yū ḇāḵ la·‘ă·rōḇ ma·‘ă·rā·ḇêḵ
verses.literal: The elders of Gebal were aboard as shipwrights repairing your leaks All the ships of the sea and their sailors came alongside to barter for your merchandise
verses.literalPt: Os anciãos de Gebal e seus sábios foram em ti os que consertavam as tuas fendas; todos os navios do mar e os marinheiros se acharam em ti, para tratarem dos teus negócios.

verses.original: פָּרַ֨ס וְל֤וּד וּפוּט֙ הָי֣וּ בְחֵילֵ֔ךְ אַנְשֵׁ֖י מִלְחַמְתֵּ֑ךְ מָגֵ֤ן וְכוֹבַע֙ תִּלּוּ־ בָ֔ךְ הֵ֖מָּה נָתְנ֥וּ הֲדָרֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: pā·ras wə·lūḏ ū·p̄ūṭ hā·yū ḇə·ḥê·lêḵ ’an·šê mil·ḥam·têḵ mā·ḡên wə·ḵō·w·ḇa‘ til·lū- ḇāḵ hêm·māh nā·ṯə·nū hă·ḏā·rêḵ
verses.literal: Men of Persia Lydia and Put served as warriors in your army They hung their shields and helmets on your walls they gave you splendor
verses.literalPt: Os persas, e os lídios, e os de Pute eram no teu exército os teus soldados; escudos e capacetes penduraram em ti; eles manifestaram a tua beleza.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֧י אַרְוַ֣ד וְחֵילֵ֗ךְ עַל־ חוֹמוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ סָבִ֔יב וְגַ֨מָּדִ֔ים בְּמִגְדְּלוֹתַ֖יִךְ הָי֑וּ שִׁלְטֵיהֶ֞ם תִּלּ֤וּ עַל־ חוֹמוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ סָבִ֔יב הֵ֖מָּה כָּלְל֥וּ יָפְיֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ’ar·waḏ wə·ḥê·lêḵ ‘al- ḥō·w·mō·w·ṯa·yiḵ sā·ḇîḇ wə·ḡam·mā·ḏîm bə·miḡ·də·lō·w·ṯa·yiḵ hā·yū šil·ṭê·hem til·lū ‘al- ḥō·w·mō·w·ṯa·yiḵ sā·ḇîḇ hêm·māh kā·lə·lū yā·p̄ə·yêḵ
verses.literal: Men of Arvad and Helech manned your walls all around and the men of Gammad were in your towers They hung . . . their shields around your walls they perfected your beauty
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Arvade e o teu exército estavam sobre os teus muros em redor, e os gamaditas nas tuas torres; penduravam os seus escudos nos teus muros em redor; eles aperfeiçoavam a tua formosura.

verses.original: תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ סֹחַרְתֵּ֖ךְ מֵרֹ֣ב כָּל־ ה֑וֹן בְּכֶ֤סֶף בַּרְזֶל֙ בְּדִ֣יל וְעוֹפֶ֔רֶת נָתְנ֖וּ עִזְבוֹנָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: tar·šîš sō·ḥar·têḵ mê·rōḇ kāl- hō·wn bə·ḵe·sep̄ bar·zel bə·ḏîl wə·‘ō·w·p̄e·reṯ nā·ṯə·nū ‘iz·ḇō·w·nā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Tarshish was your merchant because of your great wealth of goods they exchanged silver iron tin and lead for your wares
verses.literalPt: Társis negociava contigo, por causa da abundância de toda a casta de riquezas; com prata, ferro, estanho e chumbo, negociavam em tuas feiras.

verses.original: יָוָ֤ן תֻּבַל֙ וָמֶ֔שֶׁךְ הֵ֖מָּה רֹֽכְלָ֑יִךְ בְּנֶ֤פֶשׁ אָדָם֙ וּכְלֵ֣י נְחֹ֔שֶׁת נָתְנ֖וּ מַעֲרָבֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·wān tu·ḇal wā·me·šeḵ hêm·māh rō·ḵə·lā·yiḵ bə·ne·p̄eš ’ā·ḏām ū·ḵə·lê nə·ḥō·šeṯ nā·ṯə·nū ma·‘ă·rā·ḇêḵ
verses.literal: Javan Tubal and Meshech . . . were your merchants They exchanged slaves . . . and bronze utensils for your merchandise
verses.literalPt: Javã, Tubal e Meseque eram teus mercadores; em troca das tuas mercadorias davam pessoas de homens e objetos de bronze.

verses.original: מִבֵּ֖ית תּוֹגַרְמָ֑ה סוּסִ֤ים וּפָֽרָשִׁים֙ וּפְרָדִ֔ים נָתְנ֖וּ עִזְבוֹנָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: mib·bêṯ tō·w·ḡar·māh sū·sîm ū·p̄ā·rā·šîm ū·p̄ə·rā·ḏîm nā·ṯə·nū ‘iz·ḇō·w·nā·yiḵ
verses.literal: The men of Beth-togarmah . . . exchanged horses war horses and mules for your wares
verses.literalPt: Os da casa de Togarma trocavam pelas tuas mercadorias, cavalos, e cavaleiros e mulos.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י דְדָן֙ רֹֽכְלַ֔יִךְ אִיִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים סְחֹרַ֣ת יָדֵ֑ךְ קַרְנ֥וֹת שֵׁן֙ וְהוֹבְנִים הֵשִׁ֖יבוּ אֶשְׁכָּרֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ḏə·ḏān rō·ḵə·la·yiḵ ’î·yîm rab·bîm sə·ḥō·raṯ yā·ḏêḵ qar·nō·wṯ šên wə·hō·ḇə·nīm hê·šî·ḇū ’eš·kā·rêḵ
verses.literal: The men of Dedan were your clients many coastlands were your market . . . they paid you with . . . ivory tusks and ebony
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Dedã eram os teus mercadores; muitas ilhas eram o comércio da tua mão; dentes de marfim e pau de ébano tornavam a dar-te em presente.

verses.original: אֲרָ֥ם סֹחַרְתֵּ֖ךְ מֵרֹ֣ב מַעֲשָׂ֑יִךְ בְּ֠נֹפֶךְ אַרְגָּמָ֨ן וְרִקְמָ֤ה וּבוּץ֙ וְרָאמֹ֣ת וְכַדְכֹּ֔ד נָתְנ֖וּ בְּעִזְבוֹנָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·rām sō·ḥar·têḵ mê·rōḇ ma·‘ă·śā·yiḵ bə·nō·p̄eḵ ’ar·gā·mān wə·riq·māh ū·ḇūṣ wə·rā·mōṯ wə·ḵaḏ·kōḏ nā·ṯə·nū bə·‘iz·ḇō·w·nā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Aram was your customer because of your many products they exchanged turquoise purple embroidered work fine linen coral and rubies for your wares
verses.literalPt: A Síria negociava contigo por causa da multidão das tuas manufaturas; pelas tuas mercadorias davam esmeralda, púrpura, obra bordada, linho fino, corais e ágata.

verses.original: יְהוּדָה֙ וְאֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֵ֖מָּה רֹכְלָ֑יִךְ בְּחִטֵּ֣י מִ֠נִּית וּפַנַּ֨ג וּדְבַ֤שׁ וָשֶׁ֙מֶן֙ וָצֹ֔רִי נָתְנ֖וּ מַעֲרָבֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’e·reṣ yiś·rā·’êl hêm·māh rō·ḵə·lā·yiḵ bə·ḥiṭ·ṭê min·nîṯ ū·p̄an·naḡ ū·ḏə·ḇaš wā·še·men wā·ṣō·rî nā·ṯə·nū ma·‘ă·rā·ḇêḵ
verses.literal: Judah and the land of Israel . . . traded with you they exchanged wheat from Minnith cakes and honey oil and balm for your merchandise
verses.literalPt: Judá e a terra de Israel, eram os teus mercadores; pelas tuas mercadorias trocavam trigo de Minite, e Panague, e mel, azeite e bálsamo.

verses.original: דַּמֶּ֧שֶׂק סֹחַרְתֵּ֛ךְ בְּרֹ֥ב מַעֲשַׂ֖יִךְ מֵרֹ֣ב כָּל־ ה֑וֹן בְּיֵ֥ין חֶלְבּ֖וֹן וְצֶ֥מֶר צָֽחַר׃
verses.transliteration: dam·me·śeq sō·ḥar·têḵ bə·rōḇ ma·‘ă·śa·yiḵ mê·rōḇ kāl- hō·wn bə·yên ḥel·bō·wn wə·ṣe·mer ṣā·ḥar
verses.literal: Because of your many products and your great wealth of goods Damascus traded with you wine from Helbon wool from Zahar
verses.literalPt: Damasco negociava contigo, por causa da multidão das tuas obras, por causa da abundância de toda a sorte de riqueza, dando em troca vinho de Helbom e lã branca.

verses.original: וְדָ֤ן וְיָוָן֙ מְאוּזָּ֔ל בְּעִזְבוֹנַ֖יִךְ נָתָ֑נּוּ בַּרְזֶ֤ל עָשׁוֹת֙ קִדָּ֣ה וְקָנֶ֔ה בְּמַעֲרָבֵ֖ךְ הָיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏān wə·yā·wān mə·’ūz·zāl bə·‘iz·ḇō·w·na·yiḵ nā·ṯān·nū bar·zel ‘ā·šō·wṯ qid·dāh wə·qā·neh bə·ma·‘ă·rā·ḇêḵ hā·yāh
verses.literal: and casks of wine . . . from Izal for your wares Wrought iron cassia and sweet cane were exchanged for your merchandise
verses.literalPt: Também Dã e Javã, de Uzal, pelas tuas mercadorias, davam em troca ferro trabalhado, cássia e cálamo aromático, que assim entravam no teu comércio.

verses.original: דְּדָן֙ רֹֽכַלְתֵּ֔ךְ בְבִגְדֵי־ חֹ֖פֶשׁ לְרִכְבָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: də·ḏān rō·ḵal·têḵ ḇə·ḇiḡ·ḏê- ḥō·p̄eš lə·riḵ·bāh
verses.literal: Dedan was your merchant in saddlecloths . . . for riding
verses.literalPt: Dedã negociava contigo com panos preciosos para carros.

verses.original: עֲרַב֙ וְכָל־ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י קֵדָ֔ר הֵ֖מָּה סֹחֲרֵ֣י יָדֵ֑ךְ בְּכָרִ֤ים וְאֵילִים֙ וְעַתּוּדִ֔ים בָּ֖ם סֹחֲרָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·raḇ wə·ḵāl nə·śî·’ê qê·ḏār hêm·māh sō·ḥă·rê yā·ḏêḵ bə·ḵā·rîm wə·’ê·lîm wə·‘at·tū·ḏîm bām sō·ḥă·rā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar . . . were your customers . . . trading in lambs rams and goats
verses.literalPt: A Arábia, e todos os príncipes de Quedar, eram mercadores ao teu serviço, com cordeiros, carneiros e bodes; nestas coisas negociavam contigo.

verses.original: רֹכְלֵ֤י שְׁבָא֙ וְרַעְמָ֔ה הֵ֖מָּה רֹכְלָ֑יִךְ בְּרֹ֨אשׁ כָּל־ בֹּ֜שֶׂם וּבְכָל־ אֶ֤בֶן יְקָרָה֙ וְזָהָ֔ב נָתְנ֖וּ עִזְבוֹנָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: rō·ḵə·lê šə·ḇā wə·ra‘·māh hêm·māh rō·ḵə·lā·yiḵ bə·rōš kāl- bō·śem ū·ḇə·ḵāl ’e·ḇen yə·qā·rāh wə·zā·hāḇ nā·ṯə·nū ‘iz·ḇō·w·nā·yiḵ
verses.literal: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah . . . traded with you for your wares they exchanged gold the finest of all spices and precious stones
verses.literalPt: Os mercadores de Sabá e Raamá eram os teus mercadores; em todos os seus mais finos aromas, em toda a pedra preciosa e ouro, negociaram nas tuas feiras.

verses.original: חָרָ֤ן וְכַנֵּה֙ וָעֶ֔דֶן רֹכְלֵ֖י שְׁבָ֑א אַשּׁ֖וּר כִּלְמַ֥ד רֹכַלְתֵּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·rān wə·ḵan·nêh wā·‘e·ḏen rō·ḵə·lê šə·ḇā ’aš·šūr kil·maḏ rō·ḵal·têḵ
verses.literal: Haran Canneh and Eden traded with you and so did the merchants of Sheba Asshur and Chilmad
verses.literalPt: Harã, e Cane e Éden, os mercadores de Sabá, Assur e Quilmade negociavam contigo.

verses.original: הֵ֤מָּה רֹכְלַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּמַכְלֻלִ֔ים בִּגְלוֹמֵי֙ תְּכֵ֣לֶת וְרִקְמָ֔ה וּבְגִנְזֵ֖י בְּרֹמִ֑ים בַּחֲבָלִ֧ים חֲבֻשִׁ֛ים וַאֲרֻזִ֖ים בְּמַרְכֻלְתֵּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh rō·ḵə·la·yiḵ ḇə·maḵ·lu·lîm biḡ·lō·w·mê tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·riq·māh ū·ḇə·ḡin·zê bə·rō·mîm ba·ḥă·ḇā·lîm ḥă·ḇu·šîm wa·’ă·ru·zîm bə·mar·ḵul·têḵ
verses.literal: In your marketplace they traded with you fine garments of blue embroidered work and multicolored rugs with cords tightly twisted and knotted
verses.literalPt: Estes eram teus mercadores em roupas escolhidas, em pano de azul, e bordados, e em cofres de roupas preciosas, amarrados com cordas e feitos de cedros, entre tua mercadoria.

verses.original: אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֔ישׁ שָׁרוֹתַ֖יִךְ מַעֲרָבֵ֑ךְ וַתִּמָּלְאִ֧י וַֽתִּכְבְּדִ֛י מְאֹ֖ד בְּלֵ֥ב־ יַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’o·nî·yō·wṯ tar·šîš šā·rō·w·ṯa·yiḵ ma·‘ă·rā·ḇêḵ wat·tim·mā·lə·’î wat·tiḵ·bə·ḏî mə·’ōḏ bə·lêḇ yam·mîm
verses.literal: The ships of Tarshish carried your merchandise And you were filled with heavy cargo . . . in the heart of the sea
verses.literalPt: Os navios de Társis eram as tuas caravanas que traziam tuas mercadorias; e te encheste, e te glorificaste muito no meio dos mares.

verses.original: בְּמַ֤יִם רַבִּים֙ הֱבִיא֔וּךְ הַשָּׁטִ֖ים אֹתָ֑ךְ ר֚וּחַ הַקָּדִ֔ים שְׁבָרֵ֖ךְ בְּלֵ֥ב יַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ma·yim rab·bîm hĕ·ḇî·’ūḵ haš·šā·ṭîm ’ō·ṯāḵ rū·aḥ haq·qā·ḏîm šə·ḇā·rêḵ bə·lêḇ yam·mîm
verses.literal: Your oarsmen have brought you onto the high seas but the east wind will shatter you in the heart of the sea
verses.literalPt: Os teus remadores te conduziram sobre grandes águas; o vento oriental te quebrou no meio dos mares.

verses.original: הוֹנֵךְ֙ וְעִזְבוֹנַ֔יִךְ מַעֲרָבֵ֕ךְ מַלָּחַ֖יִךְ וְחֹבְלָ֑יִךְ מַחֲזִיקֵ֣י בִדְקֵ֣ך וְֽעֹרְבֵ֣י מַ֠עֲרָבֵךְ וְכָל־ אַנְשֵׁ֨י מִלְחַמְתֵּ֜ךְ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֗ךְ וּבְכָל־ קְהָלֵךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּתוֹכֵ֔ךְ יִפְּלוּ֙ בְּלֵ֣ב יַמִּ֔ים בְּי֖וֹם מַפַּלְתֵּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·nêḵ wə·‘iz·ḇō·w·na·yiḵ ma·‘ă·rā·ḇêḵ mal·lā·ḥa·yiḵ wə·ḥō·ḇə·lā·yiḵ ma·ḥă·zî·qê ḇiḏ·qēḵ wə·‘ō·rə·ḇê ma·‘ă·rā·ḇêḵ wə·ḵāl ’an·šê mil·ḥam·têḵ ’ă·šer- bāḵ ū·ḇə·ḵāl qə·hā·lêḵ ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·w·ḵêḵ yip·pə·lū bə·lêḇ yam·mîm bə·yō·wm map·pal·têḵ
verses.literal: Your wealth wares and merchandise your sailors captains and shipwrights . . . your merchants . . . and all the warriors . . . within you with all the other people on board - will sink into the heart of the sea on the day of your downfall
verses.literalPt: As tuas riquezas, as tuas feiras, e tuas mercadorias, os teus marinheiros, os teus pilotos, os que consertavam as tuas fendas, os que faziam os teus negócios, e todos os teus soldados, que estão em ti, juntamente com toda a tua companhia, que está no meio de ti, cairão no meio dos mares no dia da tua queda,

verses.original: לְק֖וֹל זַעֲקַ֣ת חֹבְלָ֑יִךְ יִרְעֲשׁ֖וּ מִגְרֹשֽׁוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: lə·qō·wl za·‘ă·qaṯ ḥō·ḇə·lā·yiḵ yir·‘ă·šū miḡ·rō·šō·wṯ
verses.literal: The countryside will shake when your sailors cry out
verses.literalPt: Ao estrondo da gritaria dos teus pilotos tremerão os arrabaldes.

verses.original: וְֽיָרְד֞וּ מֵאָנִיּֽוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּ֚ל תֹּפְשֵׂ֣י מָשׁ֔וֹט מַלָּחִ֕ים כֹּ֖ל חֹבְלֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ יַעֲמֹֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·rə·ḏū mē·ʾå̄·nī·yō·ṯē·hɛm kōl tō·p̄ə·śê mā·šō·wṭ mal·lā·ḥîm kōl ḥō·ḇə·lê hay·yām ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ya·‘ă·mō·ḏū
verses.literal: All who handle the oars will abandon their ships The sailors and all the captains of the sea will stand on the shore
verses.literalPt: E todos os que pegam no remo, os marinheiros, e todos os pilotos do mar descerão de seus navios, e pararão em terra.

verses.original: וְהִשְׁמִ֤יעוּ עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּקוֹלָ֔ם וְיִזְעֲק֖וּ מָרָ֑ה וְיַעֲל֤וּ עָֽפָר֙ עַל־ רָ֣אשֵׁיהֶ֔ם בָּאֵ֖פֶר יִתְפַּלָּֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·mî·‘ū ‘ā·la·yiḵ bə·qō·w·lām wə·yiz·‘ă·qū mā·rāh wə·ya·‘ă·lū ‘ā·p̄ār ‘al- rā·šê·hem bā·’ê·p̄er yiṯ·pal·lā·šū
verses.literal: They will raise their voices for you and cry out bitterly They will throw dust on their heads and roll in ashes
verses.literalPt: E farão ouvir a sua voz sobre ti, e gritarão amargamente; e lançarão pó sobre as cabeças, e na cinza se revolverão.

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֤יחוּ אֵלַ֙יִךְ֙ קָרְחָ֔ה וְחָגְר֖וּ שַׂקִּ֑ים וּבָכ֥וּ אֵלַ֛יִךְ בְּמַר־ נֶ֖פֶשׁ מִסְפֵּ֥ד מָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rî·ḥū ’ê·la·yiḵ qā·rə·ḥāh wə·ḥā·ḡə·rū śaq·qîm ū·ḇā·ḵū ’ê·la·yiḵ bə·mar- ne·p̄eš mis·pêḏ mār
verses.literal: They will shave their heads . . . for you and wrap themselves in sackcloth They will weep over you with anguish of soul and bitter mourning
verses.literalPt: E far-se-ão calvos por tua causa, e cingir-se-ão de sacos, e chorarão sobre ti com amargura de alma, e com amarga lamentação.

verses.original: וְנָשְׂא֨וּ אֵלַ֤יִךְ בְּנִיהֶם֙ קִינָ֔ה וְקוֹנְנ֖וּ עָלָ֑יִךְ מִ֣י כְצ֔וֹר כְּדֻמָ֖ה בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·śə·’ū ’ê·la·yiḵ bə·nî·hem qî·nāh wə·qō·wn·nū ‘ā·lā·yiḵ mî ḵə·ṣō·wr kə·ḏu·māh bə·ṯō·wḵ hay·yām
verses.literal: As they wail and mourn over you they will take up a lament for you Who was ever like Tyre silenced in the middle of the sea
verses.literalPt: E no seu pranto levantarão uma lamentação sobre ti, e lamentarão sobre ti, dizendo: Quem foi como Tiro, como a que foi destruída no meio do mar?

verses.original: בְּצֵ֤את עִזְבוֹנַ֙יִךְ֙ מִיַּמִּ֔ים הִשְׂבַּ֖עַתְּ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים בְּרֹ֤ב הוֹנַ֙יִךְ֙ וּמַ֣עֲרָבַ֔יִךְ הֶעֱשַׁ֖רְתְּ מַלְכֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṣêṯ ‘iz·ḇō·w·na·yiḵ mî·yam·mîm hiś·ba·‘at ‘am·mîm rab·bîm bə·rōḇ hō·w·na·yiḵ ū·ma·‘ă·rā·ḇa·yiḵ he·‘ĕ·šart mal·ḵê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: When your wares went out to sea you satisfied many nations You enriched the kings of the earth with your abundant wealth and merchandise
verses.literalPt: Quando as tuas mercadorias saiam pelos mares, fartaste a muitos povos; com a multidão das tuas riquezas e do teu negócio, enriqueceste os reis da terra.

verses.original: עֵ֛ת נִשְׁבֶּ֥רֶת מִיַּמִּ֖ים בְּמַֽעֲמַקֵּי־ מָ֑יִם מַעֲרָבֵ֥ךְ וְכָל־ קְהָלֵ֖ךְ בְּתוֹכֵ֥ךְ נָפָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘êṯ niš·be·reṯ mî·yam·mîm bə·ma·‘ă·maq·qê- mā·yim ma·‘ă·rā·ḇêḵ wə·ḵāl qə·hā·lêḵ bə·ṯō·w·ḵêḵ nā·p̄ā·lū
verses.literal: Now you are shattered by the seas in the depths of the waters your merchandise . . . and the people among you have gone down with you
verses.literalPt: No tempo em que foste quebrantada pelos mares, nas profundezas das águas, caíram, no meio de ti, os teus negócios e toda a tua companhia.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאִיִּ֔ים שָׁמְמ֖וּ עָלָ֑יִךְ וּמַלְכֵיהֶם֙ שָׂ֣עֲרוּ שַׂ֔עַר רָעֲמ֖וּ פָּנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kōl yō·šə·ḇê hā·’î·yîm šā·mə·mū ‘ā·lā·yiḵ ū·mal·ḵê·hem śā·‘ă·rū śa·‘ar rā·‘ă·mū pā·nîm
verses.literal: All the people of the coastlands are appalled over you Their kings shudder with fear . . . their faces are contorted
verses.literalPt: Todos os moradores das ilhas estão a teu respeito cheios de espanto; e os seus reis tremeram sobremaneira, e ficaram perturbados nos seus rostos;

verses.original: סֹֽחֲרִים֙ בָּ֣עַמִּ֔ים שָׁרְק֖וּ עָלָ֑יִךְ בַּלָּה֣וֹת הָיִ֔ית וְאֵינֵ֖ךְ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: sō·ḥă·rîm bā·‘am·mîm šā·rə·qū ‘ā·lā·yiḵ bal·lā·hō·wṯ hā·yîṯ wə·’ê·nêḵ ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Those who trade among the nations hiss at you you have come to a horrible end and will be no more . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os mercadores dentre os povos assobiaram contra ti; tu te tornaste em grande espanto, e jamais subsistirá.
